reply.english: Yesterday I went to the market.
I saw my aunt by chance.
Yes, I bought a new shirt.

phrases.arabic: أَوَّل أَمِس كَانَ عِنْدِي شُغِل لَحِتَّى الْمَسَا
phrases.transliteration: awwal amis kaan 3indi shughul la7atta l-masa

reply.english: I stayed up until one o'clock.

reply.arabic: مَا قِدِرْتُ، كَانَ عِنْدِي شُغِل كِتِير
reply.english: I couldn't, I had a lot of work.

dialogue.speaker: سامح
dialogue.arabic: أهلاً فاطمة، شنو أخبارك؟
dialogue.transliteration: ahlan Fatma, shnoo akhbaarak?
dialogue.english: Hello Fatima, how are you?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: أهلاً سامح، الحمد لله تمام. وينك كنت أمس؟
dialogue.transliteration: ahlan Samih, al-7amdilla tamam. wayn kint amis?
dialogue.english: Hello Sameh, thank God I'm fine. Where were you yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: سامح
dialogue.arabic: كنت بالشغل، كان عندي دوام لحتى المسا.
dialogue.transliteration: kint besh-shughul, kaan 3indi dawam la7atta l-masa.
dialogue.english: I was at work, I had a shift until the evening.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: يا! دوام طويل! أكلت غدا؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya! dawam taweel! akalt ghada?
dialogue.english: Oh, a long shift! Did you eat lunch?

dialogue.speaker: سامح
dialogue.arabic: لا، ما كان في وقت. أكلت بس بالمسا عند البيت.
dialogue.transliteration: la, ma kaan fi wa2it. akalt bas bal-masa 3ind al-bayt.
dialogue.english: No, there wasn't time. I only ate in the evening at home.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: مسكين! أنا روحت السوق أمس واشتريت أغراض.
dialogue.transliteration: miskin! ana ru7t as-soog amis w-shtareet aghraa2.
dialogue.english: Poor you! I went to the market yesterday and bought some things.

dialogue.speaker: سامح
dialogue.arabic: شنو اشتريتي؟
dialogue.transliteration: shnoo shtareeti?
dialogue.english: What did you buy?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: اشتريت كُمّ وشوية خضار وبعض البهارات.
dialogue.transliteration: shtareet kumm w-shwayyit khudaar w-ba3ad al-biharat.
dialogue.english: I bought some shirts, some vegetables, and some spices.

dialogue.speaker: سامح
dialogue.arabic: تمام، وبعدين شنو عملتي؟
dialogue.transliteration: tamam, w-ba3dain shnoo 3imiltee?
dialogue.english: Okay, and then what did you do?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: قعدت عند صحبتي شوي وشربنا شاي.
dialogue.transliteration: 2a3adt 3ind sa7bti shway w-shribna shay.
dialogue.english: I sat at my friend's place a bit and we drank tea.

dialogue.speaker: سامح
dialogue.arabic: كتير حلو. أنا نمت بدري أمس من التعب.
dialogue.transliteration: kitir 7ilu. ana nimt bidri amis min at-ta3ab.
dialogue.english: Very nice. I slept early yesterday from tiredness.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: استريح شوي اليوم إن شاء الله.
dialogue.transliteration: istri7 shway al-yoom in sha2 allah.
dialogue.english: Rest a bit today, God willing.

response.english: I didn't do anything, I stayed at home.

pair.english: Where were you at seven o'clock yesterday?
Did you eat something good yesterday?

response.english: Yes, we cooked kibbeh and it was delicious.
It was quiet, I slept early.

lessons.culture: In Yemeni speech, "أمس" is the everyday word for yesterday, and "البارحة" refers to last night specifically. Asking "شنو عملت أمس؟" is a natural way to start a conversation with a friend or family member, and the response usually mentions work, visiting, or market activities.

exercises.prompt: صاحبك بيسألك: "شنو عملت أمس؟". جاوب إنك روحت السوق.

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA but too formal for everyday speech; روحت is what Yemenis say.

exercises.prompt: بيسألوك: "وين كنت أمس بالليل؟". جاوب إنك كنت بالبيت.

too_formal.feedback: المنزل is written; Yemenis say البيت.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "_____ كان يوم طويل." المعنى: Yesterday was a long day.

too_formal.feedback: أمس without the article is the natural way to say it.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "أمس تعبت كتير من _____." المعنى: I got very tired from work yesterday.

too_formal.feedback: العمل is formal; the everyday word is الشغل.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "What did you do yesterday?"

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA, but شنو is the Yemeni word for what.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "Who did you see yesterday?"

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA; Yemeni says مين for who and شفت for saw.

exercises.prompt: أي جملة معناها "I bought a new shirt yesterday"؟

too_formal.feedback: Grammatically fine MSA, but أمس and كُمّ are the spoken forms.

exercises.tip: A past-tense verb plus أمس marks something already done.

exercises.prompt: شنو معنى "قديش سهرت أمس؟"؟
exercises.answer: How late did you stay up yesterday?
accepted: How late did you stay up yesterday?
options: How late did you stay up yesterday?

exercises.prompt: رتب الجملة: أمس الجو كان حلو كتير
رتب الجملة: أمس تعبت كتير من الشغل

phrases.arabic: وَقْتَ مَا كِنْتُ صِغِير كِنْتُ أَحِبّ أِلْعِب بَرَّا
phrases.transliteration: wa2t ma kintu 2aghir kintu a7ibb al3ab barra

phrases.arabic: تَرَبَّيْتُ فِي حَيّ قَدِيم فِي الصَّنْعَاء
phrases.english: I grew up in an old neighborhood in Sana'a.

phrases.arabic: كِلّ صَيْف كِنَّا نِرُوح عِنْد جِدِّي فِي الْقَرْيَة
phrases.transliteration: kull sayf kinna nru7 3ind jiddi fi al-2arya

phrases.arabic: جِدِّتِي كَانِت تِحْكِيلِنَا قِصَص قِبْل النَّوْم
أَوَّل دِرَّاجَة كَانَ عِنْدِي كَانِت حِمْرَا
كِنْتُ أَخَاف مِنَ الظَّلَام كِتِير وَقْتَ مَا كِنْتُ صِغِير
phrases.transliteration: kintu akhaf min az-Zalaam kitir wa2t ma kintu 2aghir

phrases.arabic: كِنَّا نِمْشِي إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَة سَوَّا كِلّ يَوْم
phrases.transliteration: kinna nimshi ila al-madrasa sawwa kull yom

phrases.arabic: وَقْتَ مَا كِنْتُ صِغِير حِلِمْتُ إِنِّي صِير طَيَّار
phrases.transliteration: wa2t ma kintu 2aghir 7ilmt inni Seer Tayyar

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: سارة، بتفتكري بيتكم القديم؟
dialogue.transliteration: sara, btaftikri baytkom al-2adim?
dialogue.english: Sarah, do you remember your old house?

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: أكيد بافتكر، تربيت فيه لحتى عمري عشر سنين.
dialogue.transliteration: akid baftikir, tarabbayt fi la7atta 3omri 3ashr snin.
dialogue.english: Of course I remember, I grew up in it until I was ten.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: شنو كنتي تلعبي بالحارة؟
dialogue.transliteration: shnoo kinti til3abi bil-7ara?
dialogue.english: What did you used to play in the alley?

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: كنا نلعب كورة مع ولاد الجيران وحروج.
dialogue.transliteration: kinna nil3ab kura ma3 wlad al-jiran w-7arooj.
dialogue.english: We used to play ball with the neighbors' kids and running games.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: وأنا كنت ألعب كرة قدم كل مسا مع الأولاد.
dialogue.transliteration: w-ana kint al3ab kurt 2adam kull masa ma3 al-awlad.
dialogue.english: And I used to play soccer every evening with the boys.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: بتفتكري معلمتك بالابتدائي؟
dialogue.transliteration: btaftikri mu3allimtak bil-ibtida2i?
dialogue.english: Do you remember your teacher in elementary school?

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: إي، كان اسمه الأستاذ محمود وكان صارم كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: ee, kaan ismo al-ostaaz mahmud w-kaan Sarim kitir.
dialogue.english: Yes, his name was Mahmoud and he was very strict.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: معلمتي كانت طيبة، كانت تعطينا حلويات أحياناً.
dialogue.transliteration: mu3allimti kanat Tayba, kanat ta3teena 7alawiyyat a7yanan.
dialogue.english: My teacher was nice, she used to give us sweets sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: وقتئذ كنا نمشي عالمدرسة، هسع كل شي بالسيارة.
dialogue.transliteration: wa2t2iz kinna nimshi 3al-madrasa, hassa3 kull shay bes-sayyara.
dialogue.english: Back then we walked to school, now everything is by car.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: صحيح، الحياة كانت أبسط بكتير وقتئذ.
dialogue.transliteration: Sa7i7, al-7ayah kanat absat bikitir wa2t2iz.
dialogue.english: True, life was much simpler back then.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: بفتكر أول دراجة كان عندي، كانت حمراء وكنت أحبها كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: baftikir awwal diraja kaan 3indi, kanat 7amraa w-kint a7ebba kitir.
dialogue.english: I remember my first bike, it was red and I loved it so much.

dialogue.speaker: سارة
dialogue.arabic: يا زمان! هسع الأولاد حتى ما يعرفوا الألعاب الزمان.
dialogue.transliteration: ya zaman! hassa3 al-awlad 7atta ma ya3rafo al-al3ab az-zaman.
dialogue.english: Oh those days! Now kids don't even know the old games.

response.english: I grew up in old Sana'a.

pair.arabic: شنو كنتوا تلعبوا لما كنتوا صغار؟
pair.english: What did you used to play when you were kids?

response.english: We used to play ball and old games.

pair.english: Who used to tell you stories?

response.english: My grandmother used to tell us every night.

pair.arabic: شنو كان حلمك وقت ما كنت صغير؟
pair.english: What was your dream when you were young?

response.english: My dream was to become a teacher.

lessons.culture: Yemeni families, especially in Sana'a, place great value on childhood memories and growing up in the old city quarters. Grandparents' stories and summer visits to the village are central to Yemeni family culture. The phrase "وقت ما كنت صغير" is the natural way to begin childhood stories.

exercises.prompt: صاحبك بيسألك: "وين تربيت؟". جاوب إنك تربيت في الصنعاء.

too_formal.feedback: نشأت is literary MSA; the spoken verb is تربيت.

exercises.prompt: بيسألوك: "شنو كان حلمك وقت ما كنت صغير؟". جاوب إنه كان حلمك تصير طيار.

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA, but إني صير is the natural spoken way.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "كنا _____ كورة بالحارة." المعنى: We used to play soccer in the alley.

too_formal.feedback: نلهو is literary; everyday speech uses نلعب.

exercises.tip: "كنا" plus a present-tense verb marks habitual past action.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "جدتي كانت _____ قصص قبل النوم." المعنى: My grandmother used to tell us stories before sleeping.

too_formal.feedback: تروي is written narration; تحكيلنا is how it's really said.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "I had a friend named Kareem."

too_formal.feedback: لدي and يُدعى are formal; spoken Yemeni uses عندي and اسمه.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "We used to walk to school together."

too_formal.feedback: Correct but stiff; نمشي and سوّا are the natural spoken forms.

exercises.prompt: أي جملة معناها "Back then life was much simpler"؟

too_formal.item: كانت الحياة في الماضي أبسط بكثير
too_formal.feedback: Correct but formal; وقتئذ is how Yemenis say "back then".

exercises.prompt: شنو معنى "كنت أخاف من الظلام كتير"؟
exercises.answer: I used to be very afraid of the dark
accepted: I used to be very afraid of the dark
options: I used to be very afraid of the dark
I used to love the dark
I am afraid of loud noises
I used to play in the dark

exercises.prompt: رتب الجملة: كل صيف كنا نروح عند جدي
exercises.answer: كل صيف كنا نروح عند جدي
accepted: كل صيف كنا نروح عند جدي

exercises.prompt: رتب الجملة: أول دراجة كان عندي كانت حمراء
exercises.answer: أَوَّل دِرَّاجَة كَانَ عِنْدِي كَانِت حِمْرَاء
accepted: أَوَّل دِرَّاجَة كَانَ عِنْدِي كَانِت حِمْرَاء

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.arabic: فاطمة، شكلك زعلانة، شنو صار؟
dialogue.transliteration: Fatma, shaklak za3lana, shnoo Saar?
dialogue.english: Fatima, you look upset, what happened?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: لا تسألي، يوم أسود أمس.
dialogue.transliteration: la ts2ali, yom aswad amis.
dialogue.english: Don't ask, a terrible day yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.arabic: ليش، شنو صار بالذات؟
dialogue.transliteration: lish, shnoo Saar beD-Dhat?
dialogue.english: Why, what exactly happened?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: الصبح تأخرت عن الشغل، وبعدين ضيعت مفتاح السيارة.
dialogue.transliteration: aS-Sob7 ta2akhkhart 3an ash-shughul, w-ba3dain diyyayt miftaa7 as-sayyara.
dialogue.english: This morning I was late for work, and then I lost the car key.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.arabic: يا! حرام! لقيتيه؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya! 7aram! la2iteeh?
dialogue.english: Oh no! Did you find it?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: إي، لقيته تحت الأريكة بعد ساعة دوران.
dialogue.transliteration: ee, la2ituh ta7t al-areeka ba3d sa3a dwaran.
dialogue.english: Yes, I found it under the couch after an hour of searching.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.arabic: تمام، وبعدين شنو صار؟
dialogue.transliteration: tamam, w-ba3dain shnoo Saar?
dialogue.english: Okay, and then what happened?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: وأنا رايحة للشغل خربت السيارة بنص الطريق.
dialogue.transliteration: w-ana raya7a lash-shughul kharbit as-sayyara b-nuss aT-Taree2.
dialogue.english: And while I was heading to work, the car broke down in the middle of the road.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.arabic: لا! وشنو عملتي؟
dialogue.transliteration: la! w-shnoo 3imilti?
dialogue.english: No! And what did you do?

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: اتصلت بالميكانيكي وانتظرت ساعة على الطريق.
dialogue.transliteration: ittaSalt bil-mikani ki w-intazart sa3a 3ala aT-Taree2.
dialogue.english: I called the mechanic and waited an hour on the road.

dialogue.speaker: ياسر
dialogue.arabic: مسكينة، يوم تعبان فعلاً.
dialogue.transliteration: miskin, yom ta3ban fi3lan.
dialogue.english: Poor you, a really exhausting day.

dialogue.speaker: فاطمة
dialogue.arabic: إي، بس الحمد لله خلص وما صار حاجة أكبر.
dialogue.transliteration: ee, bas al-7amdilla khilis w-ma Saar 7aja akbar.
dialogue.english: Yes, but thank God it's over and nothing worse happened.

response.english: I lost my key and was late for work.
My phone broke and I lost all my pictures.

pair.english: How did the car break down?

response.arabic: ما بعرف، وقفت لحالها بنص الطريق
response.transliteration: ma ba3rif, wa2fit la7ala b-nuss aT-Taree2
response.english: I don't know, it just stopped by itself in the middle of the road.

pair.english: Did you find the lost bag?

response.english: No, they're still searching for it at the airport.

lessons.culture: يوم أسود (a black day) describes a day when everything goes wrong. حرام is said as sympathetic expression for someone's bad luck. It's normal to mention الحمد لله (thank God) when describing troubles, acknowledging that things could have been worse.

exercises.prompt: صديقتك بتسألك: "شنو صار معك؟". جاوبي إنه ضيعتي مفتاحك.

too_formal.feedback: فقدت is correct MSA but sounds formal; spoken Yemeni says ضيعت.

exercises.prompt: بيسألوك: "ليش شكلك متضايق؟". جاوب إنه انكسر تلفونك.

too_formal.feedback: تحطّم and هاتف are formal; the spoken words are انكسر and تلفون.

exercises.tip: "تلفون" is the everyday word for phone.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "_____ الكهربا طول الليل." المعنى: The power went out all night.

too_formal.feedback: انطفأت fits a light; انقطعت is for the whole power supply.

exercises.tip: "انقطعت الكهربا" is the phrase for a power outage.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "طحت على الدرج و_____ رجلي." المعنى: I fell on the stairs and hurt my leg.

too_formal.feedback: أصبت is MSA for injured; spoken Yemeni says عرت for hurt.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "I was late for work yesterday."

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA, but الشغل and أمس are the spoken forms.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "The car broke down in the middle of the road."

too_formal.feedback: Correct but formal; spoken Yemeni uses خربت and نص.

exercises.prompt: أي جملة معناها "I forgot my wallet at home"؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA; بالبيت is the everyday form.

exercises.prompt: شنو معنى "القهوة انسكبت على اللابتوب"؟
options: I spilled coffee on the floor

exercises.prompt: رتب الجملة: نمت وما سمعت المنبه
رتب الجملة: جرحت إيدي وأنا بطبخ

phrases.english: I heard that Ali got engaged.

phrases.arabic: لَسِع مَا تَأَكَّدْنَا، يِمْكِن تِكُون إِشَاعَة بِس
phrases.transliteration: lsa3 ma ta2akkadna, yimkin tkun eshaa3a bas

phrases.arabic: مَا تِصَدِّق شْنُو صَار أَمِس بِالْحَيّ
phrases.transliteration: ma tSaddiq shnoo Saar amis bil-7ayy

phrases.arabic: لَا تِحْكِي لِحَد، بِس سِمِعِت إِنُّهُم بِيِسَافِرُون
phrases.transliteration: la ti7ki lihad, bas smi3t innuhum bisaafrun

phrases.arabic: هَاد كُلُّه كِلَام نَاس، مَا بِعْرِف صِحِيح وَلَا لَا
phrases.transliteration: had kullah klaam naas, ma bi3rif Sa7i7 wala la

dialogue.speaker: ليلى
dialogue.arabic: هاني، ما تصدق شنو سمعت!
dialogue.transliteration: hani, ma tSaddiq shnoo smi3t!
dialogue.english: Hani, you won't believe what I heard!

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: شنو في؟ قولي لي بسرعة.
dialogue.transliteration: shnoo fi? 2oli li bisur3a.
dialogue.english: What is it? Tell me quickly.

dialogue.speaker: ليلى
dialogue.arabic: سمعت إنه علي خطب!
dialogue.transliteration: smi3t innuh 3ali khaTib!
dialogue.english: I heard Ali got engaged!

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: لا! جد؟ مين قالك؟
dialogue.transliteration: la! jadd? min 2alak?
dialogue.english: No! Really? Who told you?

dialogue.speaker: ليلى
dialogue.arabic: صاحبتي شافتن سوا بالسوق وبعدين قالتلي جارتنا الخبر.
dialogue.transliteration: sa7bti shafaton sawa bas-soo2 w-ba3dain 2altilli jaartna al-khabir.
dialogue.english: My friend saw them together at the market, and then our neighbor told me the news.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: يا! ما كنت أتوقع! وامتى الفرح؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya! ma kint atwa2a3! w-imta al-far7?
dialogue.english: Wow, I didn't expect that! And when is the wedding?

dialogue.speaker: ليلى
dialogue.arabic: لسع ما حددوا، بس رح يحكوا لأهلهم هالأسبوع.
dialogue.transliteration: lsa3 ma 7addado, bas ra7 ye7ku la-ahlom hal-osboo3.
dialogue.english: They haven't set a date yet, but they'll tell their families this week.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: تمام لا تحكي لحد لحتى يعلنوا هني.
dialogue.transliteration: tamam la ti7ki lihad la7atta y3lnu honi.
dialogue.english: Okay don't tell anyone until they announce it themselves.

dialogue.speaker: ليلى
dialogue.arabic: أكيد، بيني وبينك بس.
dialogue.transliteration: akid, beeni w-baynek bas.
dialogue.english: Of course, just between us.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: وشنو صار مع المحل يلي كان جنب بيتك؟ سمعت إنه سكر.
dialogue.transliteration: w-shnoo Saar ma3 al-ma7all yalli kaan jamb baytik? smi3t innuh sakkar.
dialogue.english: And what happened with the shop that was next to your house? I heard it closed.

dialogue.speaker: ليلى
dialogue.arabic: إي، سكر من شهرين، بس ما بعرف ليش بالذات.
dialogue.transliteration: ee, sakkar min shahren, bas ma ba3rif lish beD-Dhat.
dialogue.english: Yes, it closed two months ago, but I don't know exactly why.

dialogue.speaker: هاني
dialogue.arabic: خسارة، كان محل حلو.
dialogue.transliteration: khsara, kaan ma7all 7ilu.
dialogue.english: What a shame, it was a nice shop.

pair.english: I heard your sister got married?

response.arabic: ما في جديد، الحمد لله تمام
response.english: Nothing new, thank God everything is fine.

lessons.culture: In Yemeni communities, sharing news is a normal part of daily conversation. Islamic phrases like "الحمد لله" and calling someone "جد" when surprised show the importance of faith in everyday speech. The phrase "بيني وبينك بس" (just between us) shows respect for privacy in sensitive matters.

exercises.prompt: صاحبك بيسألك: "شنو الجديد معك؟". جاوب إنه ما في جديد.

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA but stiff; ما في جديد is how it's really said.

exercises.prompt: بيسألوك: "مين قالك هالخبر؟". جاوب إنه صاحبك قالك.

too_formal.feedback: صديق is formal; الصاحب is the everyday word.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "عندي _____ ما رح تصدق." المعنى: I have news you won't believe.

too_formal.feedback: نبأ is formal; خبر is the everyday word.

exercises.prompt: أكمل: "يقولون إنه المحل _____ سكر." المعنى: They're saying that such-and-such shop closed.

too_formal.feedback: Both are correct, but الفلاني is more colloquial and common.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "I heard that Ali got engaged."

too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA; خطب is the natural past tense in spoken Yemeni.

exercises.prompt: ترجم: "Don't tell anyone, but they're going to travel."
exercises.answer: لا تحكي لحد، بس سمعت إنهم بيسافرون
accepted: لا تحكي لحد، بس سمعت إنهم بيسافرون
la ti7ki lihad, bas smi3t innuhum bisaafrun

too_formal.item: لا تخبر أحداً، لكن سمعت أنهم سيسافرون
too_formal.feedback: Correct MSA; لحد and بيسافرون are the spoken forms.

exercises.tip: "بي" at the start of a verb marks immediate future in speech.

exercises.prompt: أي جملة معناها "My sister got married last month"؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct; الشهر الماضي is more natural than في الشهر الماضي in speech.

exercises.prompt: شنو معنى "سمعنا إنهم رزقوا بولد"؟
exercises.answer: We heard they had a baby boy
accepted: We heard they had a baby boy
options: We heard they had a baby boy
We heard they had a daughter
We heard they are getting married
We heard they are having a party

exercises.prompt: رتب الجملة: سمعت إنه علي خطب
رتب الجملة: لا تحكي لحد بس سمعت إنهم بيسافرون
exercises.answer: لَا تِحْكِي لِحَد، بِس سِمِعِت إِنُّهُم بِيِسَافِرُون
accepted: لَا تِحْكِي لِحَد، بِس سِمِعِت إِنُّهُم بِيِسَافِرُون

challenge.title: حكاية اليوم
challenge.instructions: اروح قصة عن يوم صار فيه حاجات متعددة. لازم تشمل على: (١) شنو صار أمس، (٢) مين شُفت، (٣) حاجة ضايعة أو انكسرت، و(٤) إنت تشارك الخبر مع صاحب.

dialogue.speaker: أنت
dialogue.arabic: أمس كان يوم أسود! شنو صار معي.
dialogue.transliteration: amis kaan yom aswad! shnoo Saar ma3i.
dialogue.english: Yesterday was a terrible day! What happened to me.

dialogue.speaker: صاحبك
dialogue.arabic: شنو! حكي لي.
dialogue.transliteration: shnoo! 7aki li.
dialogue.english: What! Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: أنت
dialogue.arabic: الصبح روحت السوق، شفت خالتي وأكلنا سوا. بس ضيعت مفتاحي بالطريق.
dialogue.transliteration: aS-Sub7 ru7tu s-soo2, shuft khalti w-akalna sawa. bas diyyayt miftaa7i biT-Taree2.
dialogue.english: In the morning I went to the market, I saw my aunt and we ate together. But I lost my key on the way.

dialogue.speaker: صاحبك
dialogue.arabic: لا! لقيته؟
dialogue.transliteration: la! la2ituh?
dialogue.english: No! Did you find it?

dialogue.speaker: أنت
dialogue.arabic: إي، لقيته بعد ساعة. بس السيارة خربت برجوعي.
dialogue.transliteration: ee, la2ituh ba3ad sa3a. bas as-sayyara kharbit brjoo3i.
dialogue.english: Yes, I found it after an hour. But the car broke down on my way back.

dialogue.speaker: صاحبك
dialogue.arabic: الله يعينك! يوم تعبان فعلاً.
dialogue.transliteration: allah yi3eenik! yom ta3ban fi3lan.
dialogue.english: God help you! A really exhausting day.
